data_fields.name: page_skip_keys
data_fields.donor_constant: any fresh press of jump, attack 1-4 or special skips one page; the new-key set is cleared after a drawn page

data_fields.name: noskip
data_fields.donor_constant: text model subtype noskip: the box cannot be skipped by key

data_fields.name: freeze_scope
data_fields.donor_constant: while a text box is active, every non-box entity is frozen

data_fields.name: timer_hold_per_frozen_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 added to each live timer of a frozen entity per frozen tick

data_fields.name: page_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: next-animation check against the tick counter; the delay source was not read (update_frame)

data_fields.name: catch_up_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 ticks ahead of the counter, a loop constant (not a text-box rule)

best_idea: A dialogue box is one active overlay entity that holds the other actors' timers (not their logic) while it is up, advances one page per timer tick or per fresh skip press, and removes itself when its last page is drawn.
decision_why: Keep the single active box with re-election, the held timers, the one-press-one-page skip and the self-removal, all as client presentation; reject freezing the shared zone or a server fight for a line of text, because the donor freeze is a whole-world pause and Frankendom's fights and zones are server-verified.
acceptance: A player who opens a dialogue box cannot attack or move while it is up; their attack cooldown does not run out during the box and resumes with its remaining time after the last page; one skip press shows one page; a second dialogue queues rather than replacing the box; the box closes itself after its last page with no key press.
